the proposed algorithm achieves a good trade-off between efficiency and flexibility, while the existing state-of the-art holistic twig join algorithms have a better performance when the binary structural joins in a twig pattern are of the same selectivity, but they have no support for indices on element sets.

The main takeaway from our work is that

, when the twig pattern contains a mixture of ancestor-descendant relationships and sibling relationships, the existing holistic twig join algorithms can be significantly improved by using indices on element sets.
the existing holistic twig join algorithms are not necessarily the best choice for XML queries that involve multiple element sets.
, by utilizing indices on element sets, holistic twig joins can be processed efficiently even when the twig pattern involves multiple binary structural joins.
